metadata.title: How to Make Homemade Coffee Creamer
metadata.description:
FIND DEALS, COUPONS AND TIPS AT: http://hip2save.com/
This video is about how to make homemade coffee creamer. Making your own coffee creamer is really really easy and healthier for you because it doesn't have all the additives. You can add flavours to coffee creamer too. And, since we all generally have milk the only ingredient that most people will need to go get is condensed milk. Keeping this sort of item stocked is a good idea for cooking too. I keep my coffee creamer in mason jars because it keeps better in glass. There are so many additives in regular coffee creamers that you can get in the stores. This homemade coffee creamer version is definitely healthier without all the additives. Find the full details on this creamer recipe here - https://hip2save.com/2013/04/16/video-how-to-make-homemade-coffee-creamer-with-only-2-ingredients/

nodes.plm_caption: This video features a woman showing how to make a hot chocolate drink in a kitchen. She starts by talking in front of the camera, then she shows off the milk, cornstarch and vanilla. Then, she pours the cornstarch and the milk into a measuring cup. Then, she puts the cornstarch into a jar of cocoa powder and adds a touch of vanilla and some spices. Then, she stirs it with a whisk and pours it into a mug. She is in a grey shirt and the kitchen has white cupboards.

summary.brief: A man demonstrates how to make homemade coffee creamer and a peppermint‑mocha flavored version.
summary.detailed: The video opens with music and the host, Colin, greeting viewers. He explains that the basic creamer requires only two ingredients—regular milk and sweetened condensed milk. He measures 14 oz of milk into a large measuring cup, pours in a can of condensed milk, and whiskes the mixture until smooth. He then shows how to flavor the creamer by adding two teaspoons of peppermint extract and one to two teaspoons of unsweetened cocoa powder, whisking again until the powder is fully incorporated. The finished creamer is poured into small glass canning jars, the lids are screwed on, and the jars are shaken to ensure an even texture. Colin notes that the creamer can be stored in the refrigerator for about two weeks and demonstrates pouring it into a mug of coffee.

action.detailed: Combine milk and sweetened condensed milk in a measuring cup, whisk until smooth, add peppermint extract and cocoa powder, whisk again, then pour the mixture into glass jars, seal and shake to blend fully.
action.actor: Colin, the male host wearing a grey shirt, standing at a kitchen counter

nodes.plm_caption:
The video shows a woman in a well-lit kitchen demonstrating a recipe to make a coffee creamer-like product. The person has blonde hair and is wearing a gray long-sleeved sweater with a scoop neck with a white tank top underneath. She stands in front of an island, with various cooking ingredients on its surface, including a can of heavy cream and another can that says "double brand." The camera focuses on her and the products, and she speaks as she shows how she uses them.
The woman first grabs the jar of heavy cream. She puts it into the measuring cup, adds vanilla, and stirs it with a whisk. Then, she adds several different things, including cinnamon, vanilla bean paste, almond extract, and a few drops of essential oils. As she continues to whisk, the video shows her shaking the can of heavy cream several times. Finally, she holds up the product and holds up a mug that appears to contain the coffee creamer.
The camera is handheld, capturing most of the scene, and it slightly shakes at times, but the woman remains in focus. The lighting and overall mood are bright and cheerful. The background contains white cabinets, an oven, a stovetop, a refrigerator, some brown tile, and glass windows. Additionally, there is a sink and tap to the left. All in all, the scene appears to be a cooking demonstration or video for a blog or YouTube channel.

summary.brief: Colin prepares homemade coffee creamer by whisking milk with sweetened condensed milk and adding flavorings.
summary.detailed: In a bright kitchen, the presenter (Colin) stands at a countertop and explains that a simple coffee creamer needs only two ingredients: regular milk and sweetened condensed milk. He measures about 14 oz of milk into a large measuring cup, then pours the entire 14‑oz can of sweetened condensed milk into the milk and whiskes the mixture until it becomes a uniform, creamy brown liquid. After showing the basic creamer, he adds flavorings to create a peppermint‑mocha version, mixing two teaspoons of peppermint extract and a teaspoon or two of unsweetened cocoa powder into the base and whisking again until fully incorporated. The finished creamer is poured into several glass mason jars, the lids are sealed, and he notes that the jars should be shaken before each use and can be stored in the refrigerator for about two weeks.

action.detailed: Combine milk and sweetened condensed milk in a measuring cup, whisk until smooth, stir in peppermint extract and cocoa powder, whisk again, pour the mixture into jars, seal them, and shake before storing.
action.actor: Colin, the male presenter

FIND DEALS, COUPONS AND TIPS AT: http://hip2save.com/
This video is about how to make homemade coffee creamer. Making your own coffee creamer is really really easy and healthier for you because it doesn't have all the additives. You can add flavours to coffee creamer too. And, since we all generally have milk the only ingredient that most people will need to go get is condensed milk.
